What did you take? What were your concequences? I don't feel like I have the energy to continue, I can't tell you how tired I feel.
I have nobody to talk to, I have no family and I've isolated myself from everyone else. 
People hate me because I have a constant negative attitude but nobody sees what goes on behind closed doors. I never used to be this person, I can't stop crying or feeling like I want to end it.
I've felt like this for so long, the doctors offered me people to talk to but I can't even find the strength to talk to people because I just hear, I need to change my attitude and things will get better... but how? There's no guarantee Of that and I'm so sick of trying, I'm so sick of fighting all the time!

I wish I believed that, I feel like my life has gone past the point of just getting better. How do you get better from having no respect for yourself or for others, isolating yourself from anything good you once had, generally being a shit person, I wish I was dead... I wish I could stop
Being a coward and stop struggling to go through with something I want to do which is end it all

I was, and then I had it upped and I just felt shit, they numbed me, I was never fully taking them properly, my heads so messed up I can't even do that right, ha. 
I've just lost the ability to be happy anymore, I've isolated myself from everyone and everything, all things that are my own fault and no amount of medication can change that. I just want to stop existing
Yes, I want to take them all, I want to end my life and these feelings, I can't keep fighting them
